articles.summary: MIAMI --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Dec. 4, 2025-- World Kinect Corporation (NYSE: WKC) announced today that its board of directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share, which is payable on January 16, 2026 to shareholders of record on December 15, 2025 .
articles.title: World Kinect Corporation Declares Regular Quarterly Cash Dividend and Announces Additional $150 Million Share Repurchase Authorization
